title: The 5 Best Juicers for Celery Juice
h1: The 5 Best Juicers for Celery Juice
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for juicers for celery juice, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at juicers for celery juice using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Omega J8006HDS Masticating Juicer
products.blurb: Key specs: 80 RPM dual-stage auger, 200W motor, 37oz juice container.
strengths: Strong yield on fibrous stalks without the foam a centrifugal juicer produces
200-watt motor handles a full bunch of celery without bogging down
15-year warranty matters for a machine run daily
limitations: Slower than a centrifugal juicer if you're processing multiple bunches back to back
Narrower feed chute means stalks need to be cut to length first
Small pulp bin fills quickly on a big celery batch

products.name: Hurom H-AA Slow Juicer
products.blurb: Key specs: Single auger, upright design, 150W quiet motor, Adjustable pulp control lever.
strengths: Adjustable pulp lever lets you dial in a thicker or thinner juice
Quiet enough to run early morning without waking the house
limitations: The most expensive option on this list by a wide margin
Narrow chamber means celery stalks need pre-cutting
More cleanup steps than a simple centrifugal pitcher

products.name: Breville Juice Fountain Cold
products.blurb: Key specs: 850W motor, Cold Spin Technology, 70oz juice jug.
strengths: Processes a full bunch of celery in under a minute
Large 70oz jug holds several servings without emptying mid-batch
Easy rinse-clean design, a frequent praise point in owner reviews
limitations: Lower celery yield than either masticating option here
Noticeably more foam on top of the finished juice
Louder motor, a real consideration for early-morning juicing

products.name: NutriBullet Juicer Pro NBJ50200
products.blurb: Key specs: 1000W high-torque motor, 27oz sealing juice pitcher, 3-inch feed chute with dual-size pusher.
strengths: Cheapest way to start a daily celery juice habit without a big upfront cost
Wide feed chute takes longer stalk pieces without much pre-cutting
Sealing pitcher makes it easy to juice ahead and store in the fridge
limitations: Lowest yield of the four options here on fibrous produce
Some owners report excess foam with high-water-content vegetables
Not built for the daily wear of a long-term celery juice routine the way the Omega is

products.name: Nama J2 Cold Press Juicer
strengths: Fewer parts to clean than many slow juicers

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
